verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Anrok returns a list of which customer tax ID types to collect per jurisdiction. That is a related collection step, not validation of a submitted VAT ID against official registries. Nothing in the pack documents real-time registry validation or automatic reverse-charge handling for B2B cross-border sales.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be
